subject: Pilot credit eligibility & demo SLA for Founders Lab cohort
messages:
From: Emily Saunders <emily@founderslab.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@founderslab.io
Date: 2028-08-12T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Founders Lab cohort — pilot credits & demo SLA

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick follow-up from the program side — we have a 12-company cohort running Sept–Nov and would like to confirm whether Redwood can provide a startup pilot credit allocation and a short SLA for scheduled demo requests that the cohort will have during the program (several live demos, some pre-recorded).

Specific asks:
- One-time pilot credit pool to cover model usage across the cohort (idea: $8k–$15k, flexible).
- Short SLA for demo uptime and an on-call contact during demo windows.
- Any limits on per-company token caps or concurrency we should be aware of.

I've attached a rough usage estimate for the cohort (CSV). Can you share the standard criteria you use to approve these types of credits and what you need from our side to move to approval?

Cheers,
Emily Saunders
Program Director | Founders Lab Accelerator
[Attachment: usage-estimates.csv]

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Saunders <emily@founderslab.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-12T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders Lab cohort — pilot credits & demo SLA

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the CSV. Looping in Marcus from Growth (cc'ed) to confirm numbers and the typical approval path. High level on Redwood's side:

- We can approve cohort pilot credits for program partners on a conditional basis. Typical window is 3 months.
- Approvals depend on: cohort size and demo density, expected token burn (your CSV helps), and whether the cohort runs any PII/producer workloads requiring additional compliance review.
- We provide a demo SLA for scheduled windows (targeted response within 30 minutes during a scheduled demo) for cohorts on an approved pilot. For emergency escalation we can add a dedicated on-call at an added support rate.

Marcus — can you confirm the estimate and suggest a recommended credit band based on the CSV? Also, if legal needs an SOW, we should prepare one and loop in Karthik for billing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Saunders <emily@founderslab.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders Lab cohort — pilot credits & demo SLA

Thanks — dug into the CSV and ran some ballpark math. Assumptions: 12 companies, each does ~4 short demos and 8 exploratory sessions over 12 weeks, avg prompt+response 400 tokens.

Estimated token usage: 12 * (4+8) * 400 = ~57,600 tokens. Adding buffer for ad-hoc testing and retention features, I'd recommend a $12k pilot credit to comfortably cover the cohort for 3 months at our hosted API pricing.

Notes / asks:
- Are any companies planning to run inference on private deployments or with enterprise-only models? If so, that may change the approval.
- I attached a simplified usage_estimates.csv with the per-company breakdown.

Action items:
- Vanessa: if you approve the $12k band, I'll draft the SOW language (scope, demo SLA, token caps per company) and send to Karthik for billing terms.
- Emily: can you confirm whether any cohort companies have HIPAA/PHI or otherwise regulated data?

-Marcus
Growth, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: usage-estimates.csv]

From: Emily Saunders <emily@founderslab.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-14T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders Lab cohort — pilot credits & demo SLA

Thanks Marcus — that estimate looks reasonable. A few follow-ups from our side:

- None of the cohort companies are HIPAA-handling; a couple will be testing with scraped public data or synthetic datasets.
- We'd prefer a slightly larger cushion if possible: is there flexibility to go to $15k if we can commit to a short case study and co-marketing mention?
- For demos: we need guaranteed availability between 9am–3pm PT on demo days (2–3 days during the program). The 30-minute response SLA is great, but can we get a named contact for scheduled demos?

We can sign an SOW and provide a short case-study template. If $15k is possible, happy to get legal involved and turn around the SOW this week.

Best,
Emily
Program Director | Founders Lab Accelerator

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Saunders <emily@founderslab.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T17:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders Lab cohort — pilot credits & demo SLA

Emily — happy to move forward. Summary of final offer and next steps below.

Offer (conditional):
- Pilot credit allocation: $15,000 in hosted credits for the cohort, valid for 3 months from activation.
- Per-company soft cap: $1,800 equivalent; we will monitor and allow transfers within the cohort pool if one team underspends.
- Demo SLA: dedicated named contact during scheduled demo windows (9am–3pm PT) with a 30-minute response objective; escalation to on-call engineers within 2 hours for production-impacting incidents.
- Marketing: in exchange for the $15k credit increase, Redwood requests a short (1–2 paragraph) case study and logo placement in the program partner page.

Conditions / required items before activation:
1) Signed SOW outlining scope, demo windows, and review cadence. (Attached: FoundersLab_SOW_v1.pdf — please review and send back any redlines.)
2) Confirmation that no company will run regulated workloads requiring Private deployment.
3) A point of contact for scheduling demo windows and a draft case-study approval timeline.

Karthik — can you prepare billing terms and the pilot activation procedure once Emily confirms and legal signs the SOW? Marcus — please stand by to monitor usage and adjust caps if necessary.

Emily — if you can return the signed SOW by Friday EOD, we'll target activation next week.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
